notes.title: The Update Instructions for January 2025
notes.notes:
The jumping action (press the F key) has been added. While jumping, it can increase the character's anger gauge, and it can also be used for attacking or dodging.
The special action key (press the E key) for the character has been corrected. The character can only use this special action after reaching a certain level.
The action of the character falling to the ground has been added.
The effect of the character being knocked flying after being hit has been added.
The character's walking animation is now more natural.
The difficulty of the later levels has been reduced.
